crossRefs.note: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.
An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have…
One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could…
“ ‘As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad,’ surely Yahweh says, ‘So I will give up Zedekiah the king of…
Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which…
in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,
Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns Yahweh.
His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”
They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.
Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies…
For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest…

translations.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
